sn55.26:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati ābādhiko hoti dukkhito bāḷhagilāno || || 3.
sn55.26:1.3: Atha kho Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati aññataram purisam āmantesi ||
sn55.26:1.4: Ehi tvam ambho purisa yenāyasmā Sāriputto tenupasaṅkama || upasaṅkamitvā mama vacanena āyasmato Sāriputtassa pāde sirasā vanda ||
sn55.26:1.5: Anāthapiṇḍiko bhante gahapati ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno ||
sn55.26:1.6: so āyasmato Sāriputtassa pāde sirasā vandatī ti ||
sn55.26:1.8: Sādhu kira bhante āyasmā Sāriputto yena Anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatissa nivesanam tenupasaṅkamatu anukampam upādāyā ti || ||
sn55.26:2.1: Evam bhante ti kho so puriso Anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatissa patissutvā yenāyasmā Sāriputto tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 4. Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so puriso āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtam etad avoca || ||
sn55.26:3.1: Anāthapiṇḍiko bhante gahapati ābā- duk- bāla- ||
sn55.26:3.2: so āyasmato Sāriputtassa pāde si- van- ||
sn55.26:3.4: Sādhu kira bhante āy- Sāriputto yena Anā- gahapatissa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkamatu anukampam upādāyā ti || ||
sn55.26:4.1: Atha kho āy- Sāriputto pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya āyasmatā Ānandena pacchā samaṇena yena Anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatissa nivesananaṃ tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi || || Nisajja kho āyasmā Sāriputto Anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatim etad avoca || ||
sn55.26:4.2: Kacci te gahapati khamanīyaṃ kacci yāpanīyaṃ kacci dukkhā vedanā patikkamanti no abhikkamati paṭikkamo sānam paññāyati no abhikkamo ti || ||
sn55.26:4.3: Na me bhante khamanīyaṃ na yāpanīyaṃ bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti no paṭikkamanti abhikkamo sānam paññāyati no paṭikkamo ti || || 6.
sn55.26:5.1: Yathārūpena kho gahapati Buddhe appasādena samannāgato assutavā puthujjano kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayam upapajjati || tathārūpo te Buddhe appasādo natthi
sn55.26:5.2: atthi ca kho te gahapati Buddhe aveccappasādo ||
sn55.26:5.3: Iti pi so Bhagavā || lape || satthā devamanussānam buddho bhagavā ti || ||
sn55.26:5.4: Tañ ca pana te Buddhe aveccappasādam attani samanupassato ṭhānaso vedanā paṭipassambheyyuṃ || || 7.
sn55.26:6.1: Yathārūpena kho gahapati dhamme appasādena samannāgato assutavā puthujjano kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā apā- dug- vini- nirayam upapajjati || tathārūpo te dhamme appasādo natthi ||
sn55.26:6.2: atthi ca kho te gahapati dhamme aveccappasādo ||
sn55.26:6.3: Svākkhāto Bhagavatā dhammo || la-pe || paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhīti || ||
sn55.26:6.4: Tañ ca pana te dhamme aveccappasādam attani samanapassato ṭhānaso vedanā paṭippassambheyyuṃ || || 8.
sn55.26:7.1: Yathārūpena kho gahapati saṅghe appasādena samannāgato assutavā puthujjano kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā apā- dug- vi- nirayam uppajjati || tathārūpo te saṅghe appasādo natthi ||
sn55.26:7.2: atthi ca kho te gahapati saṅghe aveccappasādo ||
sn55.26:7.3: Supaṭipanno Bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho || la-pe || anuttaram puññakkhettaṃ lokassā ti || ||
sn55.26:7.4: Tañ ca pana te saṅghe aveccappasādam attani samanupassato ṭhānaso vedanā paṭippassambheyyuṃ || || 9.
sn55.26:8.1: Yathārūpena kho gahapati dussīlyena samannāgato assutavā puthujjano kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā apādug- vini- nirayam uppajjati || tathārupan te dussīlyaṃ natthi ||
sn55.26:8.2: atthi ca kho te gahapati ariyakantāni sīlāni || lape || samādhisaṃvattanikāni || ||
sn55.26:8.3: Tāni ca pane te ariyakantāni sīlāni attani samanupassato ṭhānaso vedanā paṭipassambheyyuṃ || || 10.
sn55.26:9.1: Yathārupāya kho gahapati micchādiṭṭhiyā samannāgato assutavā puthujjano kāyassa bhedā pa- ma- apā- dugvi- nirayam uppajjati || tathārūpā te micchādiṭṭhi natthi ||
sn55.26:9.2: atthi ca kho te gahapati sammādiṭṭhi || ||
sn55.26:9.3: Tañ ca pana te sammādiṭṭhim attani samanupassato thānaso vedanā passambheyyuṃ || || 11.
sn55.26:10.1: Yathārūpena kho gahapati micchāsaṅkappena samannāgato assutavā puthujjano kāyassa bhedā- -nirayam uppajjati || tathārūpo te micchāsaṅkappo natthi ||
sn55.26:10.2: atthi ca kho te gahapati sammāsaṅkappo || ||
sn55.26:10.3: Tañ ca pana te sammāsaṅkappam attani samanupassato ṭhānaso vedanā paṭipassambheyyuṃ || || 12.
sn55.26:11.1: Yathārupāya kho gahapati micchāvācāya samannāgato assutavā puthujjano kāyassa bhedā- -nirayam upapajjati || tathārūpā te micchāvācā natthi ||
sn55.26:11.2: atthi ca kho te gahapati sammāvācā || ||
sn55.26:11.3: Tañ ca pana te sammāvācam attani samanupassato ṭhānaso vedanā paṭipassambheyyuṃ || || 13.
sn55.26:12.1: Yathārūpena kho gahapati micchākammantena samannāgato assutavā puthujjano kāyassa bhedā- -nirayam upapajjati || tathārūpo te micchākammanto natthi ||
sn55.26:12.2: atthi ca kho te gahapati sammākammanto ||
sn55.26:12.3: tañ ca pana te sammākammantam attani samanupassato ṭhānaso vedanā paṭipassambheyyuṃ || || 14.
sn55.26:13.1: Yathārūpena kho gahapati micchā-ājīvena samannāgato assutavā puthujjano kāyassa bhedā- -nirayam upapajjati ti || tathārūpo te micchā-ājīvo natthi ||
sn55.26:13.2: atthi ca kho te gahapati sammā-ājīvo || ||
sn55.26:13.3: Tañ ca pana te sammā-ājīvam attani samanupassato ṭhānaso vedanā paṭipassambheyyuṃ || || 15.
sn55.26:14.1: Yathārūpena kho gahapati micchāvāyāmena samannāgato assutavā puthujjano kāyassa bhedā- -nirayam uppajjati || tathārūpo te micchāvāyāmo natthi ||
sn55.26:14.2: atthi ca kho te gahapati sammāvāyāmo || ||
sn55.26:14.3: Tañ ca pana te sammāvāyāmam attani samanupassato ṭhanaso vedanā paṭipassambheyyuṃ || || 16.
sn55.26:15.1: Yathārūpāya kho gahapati micchāsatiyā samannāgato assutavā puthujjano kāyassa bhedā- -nirayam upapajjati || tathārupā te micchāsati natthi ||
sn55.26:15.2: atthi ca kho te gahapati sammāsati ||
sn55.26:15.3: etañ ca pana te sammāsatim attani samanupassato ṭhānaso vedanā paṭipassambheyyuṃ || || 17.
sn55.26:16.1: Yathārūpena kho gahapati micchāsamādhinā samannāgato assutavā puthujjano kāyassa bhedā- -nirayam upapajjati || tathārūpo te micchāsamādhi natthi || ||
sn55.26:16.2: Atthi ca kho te gahapati sammāsamādhi || ||
sn55.26:16.3: Tañ ca pana te sammāsamādhim attani samanupassato ṭhānaso vedanā paṭipassambheyyuṃ || || 18.
sn55.26:17.1: Yathārūpena kho gahapati micchāñāṇena samannāgato assutavā puthujjano kāyassa bhedā- -nirayam upapajjati || tathārūpaṃ te micchāñāṇaṃ natthi || ||
sn55.26:17.2: Atthi ca kho te gahapati sammāñāṇam || ||
sn55.26:17.3: Tañ ca pana te sammāñānam attani samanupassato ṭhānaso vedanā paṭipassambheyyuṃ || || 19.
sn55.26:18.1: Yathārūpāya kho gahapati micchāvimuttiyā samannāgato assutavā puthujjano kāyassa bhedā- -nirayam upapajjati || tathārūpā te micchāvimutti natthi || ||
sn55.26:18.2: Atthi ca kho te gahapati sammāvimutti ||
sn55.26:18.3: tañ ca pana te sammāvimuttim attani samanupassato ṭhānaso vedanā paṭippassambheyyunti || || 20.
sn55.26:19.1: Atha kho Anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatissa ṭhānaso vedanā paṭipassambhiṃsu || || 21.
sn55.26:19.2: Atha kho Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati āyasmantaṃ ca Sāriputtam āyasmantaṃ ca Ānandaṃ sakeneva thālipākena parivisi || || 22.
sn55.26:19.3: Atha kho Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtam bhuttāviṃ onitapattapānim aññataraṃ nīcam āsanaṃ gahetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 23.
sn55.26:19.4: Ekam antaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Anāthapiṇḍikam gahapatim āyasmā Sāriputto imāhi gāthāhi anumodi || ||
sn55.26:23.1: Atha kho āyasmā Sāriputto Anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatim imāhi gāthāhi anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi || || 25.
sn55.26:24.1: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantam Ānandam Bhagavā etad avoca || || 26.
sn55.26:24.2: Handa kuto nu tvam Ānanda āgacchasi divādivassā ti || ||
sn55.26:24.3: Āyasmatā bhante Sāriputtena Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati iminā ca iminā ca ovādena ovadito ti || ||
sn55.26:24.5: mahāpañño Ānanda Sāriputto || || Yatra hi nāma cattāri sotāpattiyaṅgāni dasahi ākarehi vibhajissatī
